content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Fredericksburg

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you hold a secondary degree or equivalent and can complete the required contact hours in project management education. No prior work experience is needed—CAPM is designed for professionals new to project management who want to formalize their knowledge quickly.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp course. This intensive format covers the PMBOK® Guide essentials and project management fundamentals in a structured, exam-focused curriculum delivered by experienced instructors.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Apply directly through the PMI website with your course completion certificate and secondary degree documentation. Pay the required exam fee at application. Our team provides guidance on documentation requirements to ensure a smooth submission process.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor support—to build confidence before test day. Schedule your exam through Pearson VUE at a Fredericksburg testing center or via remote proctoring.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn professional development units across a three-year renewal cycle to keep your CAPM active. PMI offers multiple pathways to earn PDUs through courses, volunteering, and professional activities relevant to project management.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
